description: Delete a business role of an app's project. Check first with list_app_role_grants who holds it and with get_board_policy where policies still name it: a policy that names a role that no longer exists simply matches nobody. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

key.description: Role key: a short stable id such as "manager" or "agent" (what policies name). Built-in keys: "*" (every signed-in user of the app) and "public" (anonymous visitors); they need no definition and no grant

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: delete_app_role
